encode_sentence_with_bart: encode a sentence into BPE token IDs using the BART hub interface encode method
decode_tokens_with_bart: decode BART token IDs back into human-readable text using the decode method
generate_text_with_bart: generate text from tokenized input sentences using the BART generate method with beam search
extract_features_with_bart: extract BART model features or embeddings from tokenized input using the extract_features method
fill_mask_with_bart: fill masked tokens in input text with top-k predictions using the BART fill_mask method
